source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Austria 2026-27 Puma Home Kit
source.quote: The front carries the national team crest on the left chest and a Puma Cat on the right, while additional Puma marks appear on both shoulders.
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers (same as germany-2026-home, belgium-2026-home, morocco-2026-home). FSC's launch write-up covers every mark on the shirt and kit: the ÖFB crest and Puma Cat on the chest, Puma marks on both shoulders, an 'Immer wieder Österreich' inscription on the upper back, black side panels, and matching black shorts and socks with red accents. No commercial sponsor on any placement.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: Puma's red 2026 home shirt for Austria (2026 World Cup cycle, first home shirt with black sleeves) carries only the ÖFB crest, the Puma Cat and shoulder marks, and an 'Immer wieder Österreich' inscription on the upper back; paired with plain black shorts and socks (Football Shirt Culture's launch description).
